verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp, plus a demo endpoint) for connecting Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients, with admin role/department restrictions and broad read and action tools. It also runs separate Developer MCP and Ramp Data MCP servers, and the support-article probe confirms the server is documented. Bill approvals are an acknowledged gap. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in real use, bill approvals via MCP (documented as not yet available).
